title: Khari Ennui delivers a new single "Rain"
htmlContent:
Khari Ennui delivers a new single called "Rain," a master class display of Hip Hop that hits every mark for a super dope record. It’s an impressive record to add to his catalog with him displaying greatness in every facet of music to make enjoyable music for his old and new fans alike, on what is a standout release.
